blocks.intro: In the Lincoln Square community area, which covers the west side of Ravenswood, the median home was built in 1944, and nearly half were built before 1940.

blocks.h2: How We Repair a Sewer Line
blocks.intro: Once we know what's wrong, there's usually more than one way to fix it. Which method makes sense depends on the pipe's condition, location, and how it failed.
head: Method
What It Involves
Typical Disruption
rows: A resin-coated liner is pulled through the existing pipe and cured in place, creating a new pipe inside the old one.
Minimal digging, usually just small access points
A new pipe is pulled through the old one while a bursting head fractures the old pipe outward to make room.
Minimal digging, works even when the old pipe is badly damaged
The damaged section is dug up and replaced directly.
More digging, but sometimes the only option depending on damage location and access
blocks.note: Ravenswood sewer lines often run under a front stoop, a garden and the sidewalk. The footage tells us which method avoids digging them up.

blocks.h2: Sewer Repair Questions From Ravenswood Homeowners

items.q: My two-flat's sewer is original. Should I replace it?
items.preview: Only if the camera says so.
items.answer: Not automatically. Many old lines need one section fixed, not the whole run. A [camera inspection](/chicago-ravenswood/video-camera-sewer-inspections) shows which you have.

items.q: Can the sewer be fixed without tearing up the front yard?
items.answer: Often. [Trenchless lining](/chicago-ravenswood/trenchless-sewer-repair) rebuilds the pipe from the inside through small openings.

items.q: Who pays for the sewer line in a two-flat?
items.answer: The owner is responsible for the building's sewer line and for keeping it clear. In a condo building, it's usually an association expense.

items.q: Will a repair stop storm backups?
items.answer: A repair fixes your line. Chicago's combined sewers can still back up in a big storm, which a backflow valve or [overhead sewer](/chicago-ravenswood/overhead-sewer-systems) prevents.

items.q: Does a sewer repair in Chicago need the street opened?
items.preview: Only if the break is near the main.
items.answer: Only if the damage is at or near the city main. Most repairs are on the private part of the line.

items.q: How much does sewer repair cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on the damage and method. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what the camera shows, the depth, the method and what's above the line. You'll approve a flat-rate price before any work.
